Class IuJsonbBoundedParser

java.lang.Object
iu.client.jsonb.IuJsonbBoundedParser
All Implemented Interfaces:
ScopedParser, JsonParser, Closeable, AutoCloseable
final class IuJsonbBoundedParser extends Object implements ScopedParser
The view of a parser a JsonbDeserializer reads through, limited to the value it deserializes.

Created at the value's first event. hasNext() turns false once the value ends, so a deserializer can loop until then, as the JsonbDeserializer documentation shows; a scalar value is its only event. Structure methods act only within the value. After the deserializer returns, release() skips whatever it left unread, so the conversion in control of the parser continues after the value however much of it the deserializer read.

The view doesn't close the parser it reads from, which the conversion in control of it still needs.

    • continuation

      public JsonParser continuation()
      Description copied from interface: ScopedParser
      Opens a parser over the rest of the object this parser is in, from the text the controlling conversion reads, without copying it.

      Valid between properties: at the object's START_OBJECT, or at the last event of one of its values.

      Specified by:
      continuation in interface ScopedParser
      Returns:
      parser at a START_OBJECT followed by the properties not yet read, and the object's END_OBJECT; null if the controlling conversion doesn't read from text it holds
